# U040-B-V21 original-design stickers

Updated 2026-10-26. The 16×28 mm rear label and 3.4×7 mm chip-top address-reference label are rasterized from the exact supplied original design. The chip label is a printed reference diagram; the three real lower DIP sliders remain separate moving caps.

The final PNGs are rendered directly from original outlined artwork, with corrected nonzero glyph winding. The rear label is 1024×1792 px; no low-resolution preview was enlarged and no product-photo crop is used. Labels project onto explicit existing shell/package triangles. `artwork:false` removes every label.

The table, source vectors, private source links, mappings, rendering scripts and intermediate graphics remain outside the public repository. Only final PNGs and surface registration code are distributed under the user's authorization; artwork remains its owner's copyright. See [stickers.json](./stickers.json) for public final-raster hashes and surface registration.

[sticker-check.json](./sticker-check.json) compares every nonprinted geometry buffer, index, normal, world transform, material, component state and port against the pre-edit baseline: identical. All original seven Grove ports remain, and all six outputs accept real four-wire Unit assemblies with independent detach. Mounting bores remain open. No geometry, control or electrical API was changed. PNGs were decoded and inspected as raster assets; no browser or exhaustive face review was run.
